title: Tokens Too Cheap to Meter
summary: This article explores the economics of LLM token costs and argues that as token prices continue to drop dramatically, the traditional concerns about token consumption will become obsolete, fundamentally changing how AI applications are designed and monetized.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that token costs are a primary constraint in AI application development.
why_valuable: Provides perspective on how commoditizing AI compute will shift developer focus from cost optimization to capability maximization.
